usage: The word '今年' is used to refer to the current year.
It can be used as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about events or plans occurring within this year.
You can use '今年' with time expressions to specify when something happened or will happen.
It often appears together with verbs related to planning, experiencing, or forecasting events.
In casual conversation, '今年' helps speakers quickly establish the timeframe without specifying a date.
